Rules:
STARS: HP/AD × 1 / 1.8 / 3.24. S denotes star scale; AD is current attack; P = 1 + ability-power bonuses. Listed character damage/heal/shield amounts multiply by P, except transformation stats.

DEFENSE: physical uses armor; magic uses MR. Damage multiplier = 100/(100 + defense). Strongest reduction first, then penetration; penetration cap 50%.

CRITS: basic attacks only; base 20% chance, 150% damage. Chance cap 100%.

ATTACK SPEED: base × (1 + additive bonuses) × (1 - strongest slow), clamped 0.25–2.50/s.

MANA: +10 per basic attack; +1 per 1% max HP lost, capped 8/s. No mana during casts or from shield damage. Cast spends threshold; no refund on interruption.

SHIELDS: expire after 4s unless noted; same source refreshes/keeps stronger; total cap 40% recipient HP.

HEALING: actual HP damage, no overkill; direct-damage healing cap 35%. Strongest anti-heal only.

ITEMS: 3 different items per unit. Extra item hits never crit, grant mana, trigger other items or grant lifesteal. Planning allows removal/transfer. Bleed snapshots AD; maximum 3 shared stacks.

CONTROL: stuns interrupt windups/channels. Dash has no invulnerability and needs a free landing hex. Temporary buffs refresh. Damage reduction cap 50%.

DROPS: successful creeps at rounds 4/12/20/28 grant 1/2/3/4 equipment; successful bosses at rounds 8/16/24/32 grant 3/4/5/6. Each later creep or boss grants one more than the previous encounter of its own type. Failure or draw always grants exactly 1 Rare equipment. Victory rarity: round 4 Rare; rounds 8/12 Epic; later creeps Epic and bosses Legendary. Each item is rolled independently; duplicate drops are possible.

SUPPORT EQUIPMENT: healing/shields scale from the recipient's maximum HP and the holder's healing output, not ability power. Support synergy and Rika's Ring bonuses add together. Identical Rika shields and Healing Crystal heals do not stack; Blood Supply and Signal Flare have per-recipient cooldowns. Signal Flare grants 20 mana and excludes allies currently casting. Pochita prevents lethal damage once after shields; further hits can kill. Curing Crystal cleanses the first stun and bleed, but never refunds an interrupted cast.

CLASS SYNERGIES: count unique deployed characters at 2/4/6. At six units, every class retains all of its four-unit bonuses and gains its unique six-unit effect. Support duration follows the source Support once; cast/channel lengths, permanent effects, periodic tick schedules and cooldowns do not scale. Class extra shots/echoes cannot crit, grant mana or trigger equipment.

EXPANSION CONTROL: roots prevent movement, dashes and grapples but allow attacks/casts. Silence prevents new skills, while active casts continue. Shoko removes one eligible debuff; permanent Ratio marks are removable by Shoko, but not by Curing Crystal.

TRANSFORMATION INVESTMENT: Denji, Reiner, Armin, Eren, Sabrina and Reze deal 25% more ability damage after transforming (listed damage formula × P × 1.25 before defenses). This multiplies their existing transformation/stat bonuses. Basic attacks, item damage, bleed, healing and shielding receive no extra multiplier. Armin and Reze also deal their listed body-centered burst on transformation. Other first transformation casts do not deal damage.

ABSOLUTE CONTROL: a dominated unit temporarily treats its former allies as enemies, retaining its existing equipment, mana, stats and trait bonuses. Its owner and victory affiliation never change. Its crits, equipment and skill casts work normally; controlled basics use Blue's listed multiplier. Control interrupts an existing cast when it begins. At expiry, unfinished borrowed casts stop without a mana refund; already-released projectiles keep their original target team. Control ends early if its controller dies. Bosses cannot be controlled.

kobeni.text: Dash beside target and deliver 3 strikes totaling 240% AD physical damage. Gain 20% damage reduction for 1s.

makima.text: After 0.6s, control the highest-AD eligible enemy for 2s. It fights its former team, can critically strike, trigger equipment, generate mana and cast skills. Its basic attacks deal 75% of their normal damage, multiplied by Blue's ability power, with no attack-count cap. Skills and equipment use the victim's normal stats. Afterward it cannot be controlled again for 5s. Bosses, immune targets or a lone enemy instead take (220S + 150% AD) magic damage and lose 20% AD for 4s. No stun.
